components.description:
Figma Dock-Icon (308:45902): a round, fully filled icon tile (Corner-Radius/Rounded) — app, category or file-type
marks in lists, tables and cards. Solid → Content/On-Colors (Accent: On-Accent, Neutral: Inverse); Subtle → Content/<colour>/Light.

props.name: emoji
props.description: Theme=Emoji: the emoji (or any glyph) shown instead of an icon.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma Size: XSmall 24 · Small 32 · Medium 40 · Large 56 · XLarge 80 (Image-Size tokens). Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

props.name: background
props.description: Solid (default) or Subtle; Pale is always subtle, Inverse / On-Color / Surface / Emoji always solid.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name when the icon carries meaning on its own; omit when a text label sits next to it.
